menuLabel: Generate a test, report or export
bugReportCopyFailed: Could not copy the bug report
describePlaywright: The recorded navigation and user actions as a Playwright test. With HAR replay, the network answers from session.har (download it from Generate → HAR file).
describePlaywrightMocks: The same test, with up to {count} recorded responses served by context.route mocks.
describeBugReport: Markdown with the session, errors, failed and slow requests and what the recording did not capture.
describeHar: The requests of the range as an HTTP Archive (HAR 1.2), for DevTools or Playwright's routeFromHAR.
describeGitHubIssue: An issue title, labels and a body with the session evidence.
describeJiraIssue: A Jira issue payload (summary, type, labels, description) with the session evidence.
